input.free_text_description: This system is an e-commerce platform that serves User, Customer roles. It manages core business objects including product, category, user. The platform provides capabilities for user, shopping cart, product. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage product records, so that I can track and organize product data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage category records, so that I can track and organize category data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a Customer, I want to add items to my cart and complete a purchase, so that I can buy products conveniently.
